stem:
An experiment examined the relationship between the number of miles a car traveled, y, per gallon of gasoline and the speed of the car, x, in miles per hour. The table displays the data collected.

Car Mileage Experiment

| Speed, x (miles per hour) | Miles per Gallon, y |
|---------------------------|---------------------|
| 20                        | 24.9                |
| 30                        | 28.3                |
| 35                        | 29.1                |
| 40                        | 30.1                |
| 50                        | 30.0                |
| 60                        | 29.1                |

A quadratic function can be used to model the data in the table. Which value best estimates the miles per gallon when the speed is 65 miles per hour?
visual_elements: table: Car Mileage Experiment with two columns Speed, x (miles per hour) and Miles per Gallon, y with rows: 20 - 24.9, 30 - 28.3, 35 - 29.1, 40 - 30.1, 50 - 30.0, 60 - 29.1
